item.title: Personal
item.description: Personal reflections and musings about my life. I really like to write feelings down as a way to process them and sometimes they take the form of blogposts like these.

item.title: pluto
item.description: My independent research practice focused on automation

item.title: Sapling
item.description: Saplings are single nodes or thoughts. These are generally topics I've spent a decent number of hours thinking about and contain substantial original thought.

item.title: Seed
item.description: I tend to generally bookmark things for later then revisit them when I have time. These are collections of notes on articles, books, and readings. They are the seeds that form the basis of my ideas and thoughts.

item.title: Technical
item.description: Notes and blog posts on technical subjects. Though there are a lot of technical notes in this garden, these ones are generally ready for public consumption.

item.title: Writing
item.description: A small collection of some of the writing I've been experimenting with. These are mostly unpolished experiments with fiction and essays i tend to write inspired by the arts all around

item.title: Evergreen
item.description: These are notes that are always relevant and constantly being updated and grown throughout the year.

item.title: Fruit
item.description: Of course, a knowledge index isn’t much use if it doesn’t inform future thinking and output. Fruits are what I like to call derivative or ’new’ pieces of content. This is new work created from saplings, mostly longer form essays, projects, etc. At this stage, thoughts and ideas have matured enough to be able to share and collaborate.

item.title: hawkaii's blog
item.description: Welcome! I’m hawkaii. This is my little hypertext garden on the Internet — make yourself at home! Currently, I’m exploring hackathon and what backend technology looks like . Nowadays i am fascinated by the rise of agentic technologies.
